info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Wholesale Trading Suitability Checking API
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Suitability Checking API provides financial institutions with the capability to assess the suitability of investment products for their clients. By leveraging this endpoint, users can evaluate specific parameters that align client profiles with available trading options, ensuring compliance and appropriateness. This API is essential for wealth managers, investment advisors, and compliance officers who require a systematic approach to vetting trading opportunities based on client suitability. It streamlines the decision-making process and enhances risk management practices within wholesale trading environments.

get.summary: Retrieve suitability check for the specified resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the suitability check for a specific wholesale trading resource identified by RES-100045. This is crucial for assessing eligibility and compliance with trading regulations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to perform a suitability check for wholesale trading operations. Ensure that the appropriate parameters are provided to obtain accurate results.

200.description: The request was successful and the response contains the requested data.
